title: A Verdict for the Will
author: Coral Okafor
blurb: Yara Okonkwo, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
